A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AniSDF. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures and appendices are readable and reliably matched, including relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction and rendering experiments, quantitative comparisons in Tables 1–5, component ablations and additional appendix demonstrations.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds appendix sensitivity experiments, a microphone case study, radiance-field visualizations and reflective-scene reconstructions.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same fused-granularity geometry network, ASG encoding, blended radiance fields and losses. The new appendix tests examine configurations of the existing method without revising the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: v2 Figure 12 adds qualitative reflective-scene examples, including a coral object identified as belonging to NeRO Glossy-Real. This modestly extends scene coverage; the existing datasets and tasks, including MipNeRF360 already evaluated in v1's appendix, are retained.

E2.justification: Tables 1–5 and the retained qualitative comparisons have unchanged comparator sets. NeRO in v2's microphone case study was already evaluated against AniSDF on Mic in v1 Table 1. The added branch configurations are internal ablations.

E3.justification: Existing benchmark settings remain unchanged. Additional appendix tests use maximum resolutions 1024/2048/4096, split levels m=9/10/11, alternative branch configurations and a separately tuned Mic setting. These introduce targeted experimental controls without replacing the original evaluation protocols.

E4.justification: Beyond v1's ASG and fused-component ablations, v2 Appendix A.1 adds resolution sensitivity, coarse/coarse versus fine/fine versus coarse/fine controls, split-level sensitivity and a microphone metric case study. Appendix A.2 adds branch-output visualizations. Together these substantially broaden diagnosis of the architecture and its evaluation.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The added appendix scores retain the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 are numerically unchanged. Added results include Lego CD values of 5.28 at m=9 and 5.24 at m=11, alongside 5.16 at m=10, and a fine-tuned Mic CD of 2.83 alongside the retained standard AniSDF 5.34 and NeRO 3.65 values. New ablation meshes, branch visualizations and reflective normal maps supplement these localized findings. The tuned Mic score uses different settings.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, rendering formulation and Equations 1–18 are unchanged. The added Chamfer-distance discussion is an empirical interpretation, without a new mathematical definition, derivation or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, four introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about fused-granularity surfaces, ASG-based appearance modeling, reconstruction quality and avoiding instance-specific tuning. The appendix adds support without redefining these core claims.

C2.justification: v2 Appendix A.1 newly argues that Chamfer-distance sampling can favor smooth geometry over visually accurate hollow structures, explaining the Mic discrepancy. It also discusses resolution versus memory tradeoffs. Section 6's limitations concerning rendering speed and indirect illumination remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 newly discloses a default maximum hashgrid resolution of 2048 and reports memory consumption of 24 GB, versus 32 GB at resolution 4096 and 30 GB for two fine branches. Existing network sizes, loss weights, training hardware/time and project link remain unchanged. Exact Mic fine-tuning hyperparameters are not supplied.

R1.justification: The bibliography and related-work discussion contain the same works and research positioning. The appendix reuses existing methods and references without revising novelty claims or the relationship to prior approaches.

P1.justification: v2 adds two introductory appendix subsections and renumbers the retained sections, slightly revises an appendix heading, updates author order and affiliation information, and adds an acknowledgement. The existing scientific narrative is otherwise essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Six new multi-panel appendix figures present sensitivity tests, CD-labelled reconstructions, branch outputs and reflective-scene normals. All original figures are retained; old appendix Figures 7–17 become Figures 13–23 and are redistributed. This substantially expands the visual presentation while preserving the five tables.

improvement.justification: The added appendix checks better support the grid-design choices, expose the radiance-field decomposition and explain an existing mismatch between Mic's numerical and visual quality. Newly disclosed resolution and memory information also improves transparency. These are useful but limited gains: the added evidence mainly concerns selected scenes, and the microphone tuning remains insufficiently specified.
